assertions.assertion: Implements IClientAssertionService with a GetClientAssertionAsync method
Sets the JWT Audience to the authorization server's issuer URL, NOT the token endpoint URL
assertions.rationale: Audience = "https://identity.example.com" with comment 'issuer URL, NOT the token endpoint'.

assertions.assertion: Warns about CVE-2025-27370 or CVE-2025-27371 related to incorrect audience values
assertions.rationale: Cites CVE-2025-27370 / CVE-2025-27371 and the token endpoint audience problem.

assertions.assertion: Returns a ClientAssertion with Type set to OidcConstants.ClientAssertionTypes.JwtBearer (or the equivalent string 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer')
Registers the IClientAssertionService implementation with DI (e.g., AddSingleton or AddTransient)
Sets the JWT 'typ' header to 'client-authentication+jwt' (e.g. via AdditionalHeaderClaims) to opt into strict audience validation (RFC 7523bis / StrictClientAssertionAudienceValidation)
assertions.rationale: AdditionalHeaderClaims sets typ to "client-authentication+jwt" and mentions StrictClientAssertionAudienceValidation.
